notes.title: HuniePop 2: Double Date Is Available Now!
notes.content:
Take a trip to an exotic island paradise for a steamy new adventure in the long awaited sequel to HuniePop! Available now on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/930210/HuniePop_2_Double_Date/

notes.title: HunieCam OST available for FREE!
notes.content:
Hey guys! I know people love the music and have been asking for the soundtrack. I wanted to release this sooner but I ran into seemingly every possible problem/delay! 

It's not a super long soundtrack so we are releasing it for free. You can download it here on Steam as DLC or if you prefer streaming it, our composer Jonathan is uploading it to his YT channel: https://www.youtube.com/user/WorldofWandag

http://store.steampowered.com/app/463490/

[i][b]Note:[/b] On Steam the soundtrack will be downloaded as DLC and will be contained within the same directory as your core game files. To quickly access these files right-click HuniePop in your Steam library and select "Properties". From there select the "Local Files" tab and click the "Browse Local Files" button.[/i]

notes.title: Rock Hard Mode (v1.0.2)
notes.content:
I noticed that some of you guys are very good at the game and earned the diamond trophy on your 2nd or 3rd time through. So, I just pushed an update adding a new hard mode. As long as you have earned the gold trophy or better you can start a new game file in "Rock Hard Mode" and that difficulty should be more suitable to your skill level.

I also made a few minor balance tweaks to the normal difficulty and spread out the amount of tokens you earn so you get more for playing in hard mode.

Appreciate the love guys! Keep the feedback coming on the discussion forum.

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.1
notes.content:
Just pushed a fresh build with a couple key fixes:

1. Fixed issue where the game would run extremely hot on some machines, frame rate was running wild.
2. Fixed bug where the studio report window at the end of a game session would freeze if you finished with less than 5 girls.
3. Fixed a couple spelling mistakes (stay in school kids).

Grab the latest update through Steam or be sure to re-download the DRM-free build if you are a Humble Store customer.

Thanks!
